16 · 10 resources

Ethics, safety, and regulation

If you're shipping a voice agent in 2026, disclosure and consent are no longer optional. The FCC and EU AI Act both have teeth.

Suggested learning path: Week 5: Production

10 resources

  • FCC: AI-Generated Voices in Robocalls Illegal (Feb 2024)fcc.gov

    The landmark TCPA ruling every U.S. voice-agent dev must read.

    Beginner
  • EU AI Act: Article 50 (Transparency for Deepfakes & AI Interactions)artificialintelligenceact.eu

    Authoritative text of EU disclosure rules; transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026 (systems already on the market before that date have until 2 December 2026 to comply).

    Intermediate
  • European Commission: Code of Practice on AI-Generated Contentdigital-strategy.ec.europa.eu

    Official EU implementation guidance on watermarking and labelling; the finalized Code was published on 10 June 2026.

    Intermediate
  • Digital Omnibus on AI: EU AI Act simplification (European Parliament)europarl.europa.eu

    June 2026 package (Parliament- and Council-endorsed) adjusting AI Act transparency and timeline obligations; track it for disclosure-rule changes.

    Intermediate
  • FTC: Approaches to Address AI-Enabled Voice Cloningftc.gov

    Plain-English summary of the Voice Cloning Challenge winners and Impersonation Rule.

    Beginner
  • FTC: Proposed Rule on AI Impersonation of Individuals (Feb 2024)ftc.gov

    Direct source on U.S. impersonation-fraud rules covering AI deepfakes.

    Beginner
  • Pindrop: Voice Intelligence & Security Reportpindrop.com

    Industry report documenting the sharp rise in deepfake fraud attempts.

    Beginner
  • Voice Cloning Ethics (CAMB.AI)camb.ai

    Practical overview of consent frameworks, ELVIS Act, and EU AI Act.

    Beginner
  • Detecting AI Audio with SynthID (ElevenLabs)elevenlabs.io

    ElevenLabs adopts Google DeepMind's inaudible SynthID watermark across generated audio and ships a free public Audio Detector.

    Beginner
  • NCLC: Top Six TCPA/Robocall Developments 2024/2025library.nclc.org

    Consumer-protection lens on what's actually being enforced.

    Intermediate
